description: Jiangsu Climate Center and university partners publish projected water-use efficiency across Xinjiang for 2020–2050 under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5. Two directories contain 31 gridded files each, one per year and scenario. ScienceDB repository states CC BY 4.0 for free reuse, while the inspected description does not specify the grid resolution, raster container or detailed efficiency units. These projections can inform climate-scenario assumptions for vegetation and agricultural-water simulations. They are model outputs, not measured irrigation performance, and users must check the underlying definition before translating them into water withdrawals. Uncertainty in the climate and response models is not quantified in the top-level metadata. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: Spatial dataset of water use efficiency in Xinjiang, 2020-2050 under different climate scenarios (RCP4.5 and RCP8.5)
notes: G4-0140; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
